portfolio-website.name: Portfolio Website
portfolio-website.subtitle: Showcasing My Technical Work & Background
portfolio-website.content: Dynamic website used as a platform to introduce myself, display my work, and highlight my expertise, skills and achievements in various fields.
portfolio-website.context: Multi-route responsive React application deployed on Vercel at jsondev.uk.
portfolio-website.overview: This portfolio website serves as a central platform to introduce my background, display my software projects, and document my computer science journey using a modern React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite stack.
portfolio-website.problem: Needed a fast, responsive, and maintainable personal platform to present software projects, technical skills, and professional recommendations to recruiters and collaborators.
portfolio-website.solution: Engineered a client-side Single-Page Application (SPA) with React 18, Vite, React Router v6, and Tailwind CSS, featuring centralized content constants, reusable UI primitives, accessible navigation, and Vercel rewrite routing.
highlights: Corrected legacy copy-paste metadata (previously mislabelled as a VBA project) and restructured around a modular React + Vite architecture.
Implemented hybrid client-side routing with backward-compatible redirects for legacy project links.
Designed with a custom dark Caribbean green design system, semantic HTML landmarks, keyboard focus visibility, and reduced-motion support.

contribution.role: Sole designer and developer responsible for the complete lifecycle of the portfolio website, from conception and component architecture to deployment and continuous maintenance.
contribution.approach: Developed independently using hands-on implementation paired with modern AI-assisted development tools (including LLM coding assistants) to accelerate drafting, refactor components, and streamline verification. Maintained full ownership over architectural direction, code review, manual and automated validation, and final implementation quality.
contribution.decisions: Structured as a modular React 18 Single-Page Application bundled with Vite and styled with a custom dark Caribbean green design system. Engineered a simulated Bash shell environment (/terminal and /es/terminal) with an in-memory virtual filesystem, command dispatcher, and Tab autocomplete engine running strictly on the client side with zero OS execution or network requests for security. Integrated complete bilingual routing (i18next) with localized URLs, hreflang metadata, and route-aware multilingual SEO, while centralizing site content in declarative constants.
contribution.testing: Validated using automated Node-based unit test suites for the virtual filesystem and autocomplete logic, headless browser automation for visual regressions across desktop and mobile viewports, and production build checks.
contribution.outcome: Live, production-ready bilingual web portfolio deployed on Vercel at jsondev.uk with a public open-source repository on GitHub (46lemonlime/jsondev.uk).

portfolio-website.verificationNote: Verified in repository: Full source code is present in this workspace and deployed at jsondev.uk.

call-progress-tracker.name: Call Progress Tracker
call-progress-tracker.subtitle: Boosting Customer Service!
call-progress-tracker.content: Desktop application designed to empower customer service agents during calls. Developed using VBA, helps agents deliver outstanding service and exceeding KPIs.
call-progress-tracker.context: Developed in a live call-centre environment to streamline call handling workflows and support KPI adherence.
call-progress-tracker.overview: As a former customer service agent, I discovered the crucial importance of empowering agents with the right tools to deliver exceptional customer service. Developed during my time in a call center, this application helped structure live call workflows and support agents working toward their KPIs.
call-progress-tracker.problem: Customer service agents in fast-paced call centres must track call stages, compliance requirements, and customer details simultaneously while maintaining call quality and KPI targets.
call-progress-tracker.solution: Built a lightweight desktop application using Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) to guide agents through call stages, keep essential workflow prompts accessible, and reduce friction during live customer interactions.
highlights: Designed from direct first-hand experience working in high-volume customer service operations.
Built with VBA to run natively inside standard desktop office environments without requiring external software installations.
Focused on practical workflow structure and helping agents stay aligned with call quality and KPI expectations.

contribution.role: Sole creator and developer. Conceived, designed, and developed the application while working as a customer service agent in a live call-center environment.
contribution.approach: Developed from direct operational necessity to solve first-hand workflow bottlenecks during high-volume customer calls, structuring complex stage requirements into a single accessible interface.
contribution.decisions: Built natively in Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) to run directly within the standard desktop Microsoft Office environment, eliminating the need for administrative software installations or IT policy exemptions in a restricted corporate environment. Designed sequential forms and checkpoints to guide agents through mandatory compliance verifications, account security protocols, and note-taking templates without interrupting conversational flow.
contribution.testing: Validated through personal daily operational use during real inbound customer interactions, iteratively refining button placements, keyboard accessibility, and information density based on live call speed and quality compliance audits.
contribution.outcome: Delivered a functional internal desktop productivity tool that supported call handling workflows and KPI adherence. Source code and proprietary workplace screenshots remain private due to corporate operational context.

smart-file-organizer.name: Smart File Organizer
smart-file-organizer.subtitle: Deterministic CLI File Organization & Recovery Engine
smart-file-organizer.content: Contract-first Python CLI application for deterministic file organization, dry-run simulation, execution reporting, and safe rollback.
smart-file-organizer.context: Automates directory cleanup workflows with strict separation between planning, execution, and recovery phases.
smart-file-organizer.overview: Smart File Organizer is a contract-first Python command-line application built to automate directory organization workflows (such as Downloads or Desktop folders) safely and deterministically. Designed around layered separation of concerns, it decouples discovery, classification, execution planning, filesystem operations, and rollback recovery.
smart-file-organizer.problem: Automating directory cleanup across busy filesystem locations is often risky with basic scripts: unexpected file moves can misplace data, lack execution visibility, or provide no mechanism to undo changes when rules mismatch.
smart-file-organizer.solution: Engineered an installable Python CLI tool (smartorg) featuring dry-run simulations, YAML-driven classification rules, atomic per-file failure isolation, structured JSON execution reporting, and a deterministic rollback engine to safely undo changes.
highlights: Contract-first architecture with typed dataclass models enforcing strict boundaries across discovery, operations, recovery, and reporting.
Safe execution pipeline separating planning from filesystem operations, with full dry-run simulation support.
Deterministic rollback subsystem that inverts operation paths and restores files with comprehensive rollback report persistence.
Structured key=value logging and chronological JSON report history with scoped filtering and index-based inspection.

contribution.role: Sole author and developer responsible for the architectural design, CLI specification, and core engine implementation of the smartorg Python package.
contribution.approach: Designed around a contract-first philosophy, establishing rigorous data contracts and separating concerns across discovery, rule classification, plan execution, and rollback recovery.
contribution.decisions: Engineered in Python 3.10+ using typed dataclasses to enforce immutable boundary contracts between system components. Implemented an isolated dry-run simulation mode that calculates move operations without touching the physical filesystem. Built a deterministic rollback subsystem that logs filesystem operations as inverse transformations, allowing safe one-command reversal of organized files. Integrated YAML-driven custom rule configurations, atomic per-file error isolation to prevent batch failures, and structured chronological JSON reports.
contribution.testing: Tested using dry-run verification against complex directory structures, error handling checks for locked or permission-restricted files, and automated validation of the rollback mechanism to ensure complete file restoration without data loss.
contribution.outcome: Published open-source Python package on GitHub (46lemonlime/smart-file-organizer) with full CLI tooling, documentation, and contract specifications.

smart-file-organizer.verificationNote: Verified repository: Open-source Python package with full pipeline contracts, CLI entry points, and documentation on GitHub.

ascension-tactics.name: Ascension Tactics
ascension-tactics.subtitle: Browser-Based 3D Turn-Based Tabletop Skirmish Game
ascension-tactics.content: High-performance browser-based 3D tactical skirmish game built with Three.js and TypeScript, featuring turn-based combat, 10 factions, and dynamic action cameras.
ascension-tactics.context: Interactive client-side 3D wargame delivering tactical line-of-sight calculations, vehicle physics, and tabletop rule systems in the browser.
ascension-tactics.overview: Ascension Tactics is a high-performance, browser-based 3D tactical tabletop wargame built from scratch using TypeScript and Three.js. Inspired by grimdark tabletop rulesets, it translates miniature skirmishes into an interactive WebGL experience featuring 10 distinct playable factions, multi-weapon loadouts, procedural 3D miniatures, and deterministic camera systems.
ascension-tactics.problem: Translating complex tabletop wargaming mechanics (multi-weapon profiles, range bands, line-of-sight checks, and dice-based combat resolution) into an accessible, performant browser game without heavy external game engine runtimes.
ascension-tactics.solution: Architected a custom WebGL game loop in TypeScript using Three.js, incorporating shared geometry and material caching to minimize draw calls, a deterministic action camera pipeline, line-of-sight raycasting, and isolated equipment state machines.
highlights: 10 distinct playable factions with custom heraldic emblems, unit rosters, specialized weapon ranges, and faction doctrines.
Tactical line-of-sight analysis, raycasted movement grids, and multi-weapon squad combat resolution.
Deterministic over-the-shoulder action camera that interpolates and settles before triggering animations and combat rolls.
Custom WebGL rendering architecture with geometry/material caching and realistic continuous tracked vehicle wheel kinematics.

contribution.role: Sole designer and developer responsible for the game design, 3D WebGL graphics pipeline, rules engine, and user interface.
contribution.approach: Built from scratch in TypeScript and Three.js, translating tabletop wargaming concepts into a performant, browser-native WebGL game without relying on heavy external game engines.
contribution.decisions: Architected a custom WebGL render loop with geometry and material caching to minimize draw calls and sustain high frame rates across diverse hardware. Implemented an asynchronous deterministic action camera system that interpolates over-the-shoulder and fully settles before triggering unit animations and combat rolls. Programmed mathematical line-of-sight raycasting, grid-based pathfinding, and multi-weapon equipment profiles across 10 distinct playable factions. Designed realistic continuous tracked vehicle kinematics and dynamic battlefield environments with particle weather effects.
contribution.testing: Verified through interactive in-browser gameplay sessions, performance profiling of Three.js frame rates and draw calls, and functional validation of dice mechanics and line-of-sight calculations.
contribution.outcome: Fully playable browser-based 3D tactical skirmish game deployed live at ascensiontactics.jsondev.uk with an open-source repository on GitHub (46lemonlime/ascension_tactics).

ascension-tactics.verificationNote: Verified repository & live demo: Full TypeScript and Three.js source code on GitHub, deployed live at ascensiontactics.jsondev.uk.

handlab.name: HandLab
handlab.subtitle: Texas Hold'em Range Analyzer & Companion Desktop Suite
handlab.content: Unified poker analysis suite comprising HandLab Online—a browser-based Texas Hold'em range analyzer and study tool—and HandLab Desktop, a companion application delivering extended functionality.
handlab.context: Consists of a publicly deployed web application at handlab.uk alongside a specialized companion desktop tool for extended analysis.
handlab.overview: HandLab is a comprehensive poker study ecosystem composed of two complementary applications: HandLab Online, a publicly deployed web platform for visual preflop range analysis and game-tree exploration, and HandLab Desktop, a companion application built to provide extended capabilities beyond the browser experience.
handlab.problem: Studying complex Texas Hold'em strategies and post-hand decision-making requires rapid access to visual range matrices, preflop charts, and quantitative math tools, while deeper workflows demand specialized desktop capabilities.
handlab.solution: Engineered HandLab as a complementary two-part poker study system: HandLab Online provides an interactive browser-based 13×13 range matrix, preflop solver charts, EV and pot odds calculators, and street-by-street hand replaying. HandLab Desktop operates as the dedicated companion application providing additional functionality beyond the web platform.
highlights: HandLab Online: Interactive 13×13 Texas Hold'em range matrix with action weighting, hand combo inspection, and visual range painting.
Preflop Chart Library: Positional solver charts (Open Raise, 3-Bet, 4-Bet, vs Squeeze) with custom cloud strategy creation.
Poker Math & EV Suite: Integrated EV solver, pot odds hurdle calculation, Monte Carlo simulation, and ICM tools.
Hand Replayer: Parses raw hand histories from PokerStars and GGPoker to step through played hands street-by-street with chip and pot tracking.
HandLab Desktop Companion: Extended desktop edition built to provide advanced functionality beyond the online platform.
Private Source Repositories: Developed and maintained in private repositories; live web application deployed publicly at handlab.uk.

contribution.role: Sole architect and lead developer of the entire HandLab ecosystem, responsible for both HandLab Online (web application) and HandLab Desktop (companion desktop tool).
contribution.approach: Developed as a specialized, full-stack analytics suite to address advanced poker study needs, combining browser-based visual matrix manipulation with desktop queue processing and relational persistence.
contribution.decisions: HandLab Online: Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Implemented a 13×13 interactive pre-flop range matrix, positional solver charts, mathematical EV calculators, Monte Carlo simulations, and a multi-board / Run It Twice hand replayer. Ingestion & Persistence: Engineered an AST-based PokerStars hand history parser with card tokenization, and a Supabase PostgreSQL backend with keyset cursor pagination (played_at DESC, id DESC) and database-enforced idempotency (UNIQUE(user_id, site, site_hand_id)). HandLab Desktop: Built with Tauri 2 (Rust) and React 19 + TypeScript, leveraging a local SQLite database for offline queue management and chunked desktop synchronization.
contribution.testing: Supported by an extensive automated test suite with over 250 unit and integration tests verifying mathematical parity, multi-pot distribution, rake attribution, tokenization, and state transitions (including 259/259 automated tests passing in the hand history and stats engine).
contribution.outcome: HandLab Online is deployed live in production at handlab.uk. HandLab Desktop is actively maintained in companion development. Both source repositories are managed privately.

handlab.verificationNote: Verified public deployment: HandLab Online is live at handlab.uk. Source repositories for both online and desktop applications are private.
